messages:
Aisha: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands — a few quick follow-ups on the sales pipeline / GTM / partner asks. I want us to be clear on near-term priorities and any blockers. Please post short updates and questions here.
Marco: Quick note — we have 3 deals >$250k in late stage; two are contingent on security reviews from partner legal. ETA on decisions is ~2 weeks.
Lena: From GTM: priority is focusing reps on two vertical plays (search & enterprise docs). We've updated the playbook, link: https://redwood.example/playbooks/verticals (internal). Can we confirm enablement sessions next Wed?
Devon: Partner update: signed MOU with DataCo — pilot starts in 3 weeks. Main ask: can product provide a 1-hour tech overview for their architects?
Sam: I can run the 1-hr tech overview. Proposed agenda: 1) runtime overview, 2) model routing and fallbacks, 3) SLA/observability hooks. Happy to prep slides.
Olivia: Ops note — for the two security reviews, we need the signed connector questionnaire by Thurs to hit the 2-week window. I pinged legal.
Marco: Quick Q — for the enterprise-docs vertical, what model variants should reps demo (latency-focused vs quality-focused)? Advice appreciated from product/ML.
Sam: Recommendation: show the standard 8k-quant variant for demos (balanced), and have a prepared slide showing latency vs cost tradeoffs for the 4k-quant low-latency option.
Lena: Can we get a short cheat-sheet for reps that lists the recommended model + 2 fallback options per vertical? If product can drop one-pager by Monday that'd be perfect.
Sam: Yup — will push a 1-page PDF by Monday EOD.
Aisha: Leadership ask: any blockers on hitting Q2 pipeline goals? Specific asks: resource needs, partner integrations, or anything that requires escalation.
Marco: One blocker: we need faster turnaround on demo tenants for dedicated trials — infrastructure queue is adding 3-5 days right now. If we can prioritize a few trial tenants for enterprise, conversion improves materially.
Olivia: Noted. Ops will prioritize 3 trial tenants for enterprise. Please DM me the customer names and region.
Devon: For partner enablement, DataCo asked for SAML SSO docs + a short integration checklist. Is there an existing doc or should I draft one?
Sam: We have a SAML integration guide but it's a bit outdated. I'll update the checklist and drop example SAML metadata.
Lena: Small ask: can marketing prepare a one-slide partner co-marketing outline we can show to prospects? Helps accelerate conversations.
Aisha: Good call — @marketing-led? (not in thread) but we'll loop them in. For this thread, please add any follow-ups as bullets.
Marco: Follow-ups from sales: (1) Ops to prioritize demo tenants (Olivia), (2) Product one-pager for reps (Sam), (3) Legal to expedite connector questionnaire (Olivia + Legal).
Devon: Follow-ups from partners: (1) Sam to update SAML checklist, (2) A 1-hour tech overview scheduled with DataCo — Sam to run, propose next Tue or Thu, (3) marketing one-slide for co-marketing.
Sam: Proposed times for DataCo: Tue 10:00 PT or Thu 14:00 PT. Which works for their architects? Devon will confirm.
Olivia: Ops will fast-track those 3 demo tenants — send names now and we'll queue them.
Aisha: Thanks all — I'll escalate the infrastructure queue priority to execs if we see no movement by Friday. One ask: keep updates here so we have a single source of truth. :thumbsup:
AllhandsBot: Recording and slides uploaded: https://redwood.example/allhands/1938452100 (auto-post)
Marco: Thanks — will post the 3 customer names in a follow-up DM to Olivia.
Devon: I'll ping DataCo and lock in Tue 10:00 PT if they're available.
Lena: I'll book next Wed enablement session and invite the reps. Agenda will be the new vertical playbook + cheat-sheet.
Sam: PDF and SAML checklist will be in #docs by Monday.
Aisha: Great closure. If anyone has urgent items, reply here; otherwise we'll reconvene on Friday for a quick sync.
